[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Australian Federal Government has committed to banning all single-use plastics by 2025, including plastic straws, cutlery, and plates.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Australian Government has established a $100 million fund to develop innovative solutions to reduce plastic waste and support new recycling technologies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] In March 2019, the Australian Capital Territory (ACT) became the first Australian jurisdiction to ban single-use plastics including straws, cutlery, and stirrers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Many supermarkets across Australia are phasing out the use of single-use plastic bags and encouraging customers to use reusable bags.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Organizations such as Sea Shepherd conduct regular beach cleanups around Australia to remove plastic and other marine debris from the coastline.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Greenpeace Australia Pacific runs campaigns to raise awareness about the impact of plastic pollution on marine life and encourages people to reduce their plastic consumption.
